newsitem.title: USA: Duke reduces power at 1,129 MW N.C. nuke.
newsitem.headline: Duke reduces power at 1,129 MW N.C. nuke.

text.p: Duke Power Co is reducing power output at its 1,129 megawatt (MW) McGuire 2 nuclear power unit to 25 percent of capacity early Friday for testing, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Friday.

The unit, located in Cornelius, N.C., was operating at 35 percent of capacity and "decreasing power to 25 percent for performance of feedwater containment isolation valve testing," the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
Company officials were not immediately available to comment on the length of the power reduction.
The adjacent 1,129 megawatt McGuire 1 unit has been shut since Feb 14 for scheduled maintenance and refueling, and was expected to return to service in late May.
